_about: Everyone a slice quest places who has no quest topic of their own (owner walk 4, 2026-11-08: everyone in the places the slice quests touch has dialogue). One reply each to the prompt, built into ARG_Talk (QuestPeople in Talk.cs) gated GetIsID to the base; 'when' gates it on a quest's stage (lo inclusive, hi exclusive). Read by the echo check (tools/argonia_world/echoes.py), not the build: 'facts' lists the quest fact ids a reply states; 'speaker' names the person when a second base stands in for them elsewhere.

lines: Hides-His-Wake. I work this camp, and I do not talk about it with strangers. Go back the way you came.
Counts-The-Jars. I tend the jars of sap at this camp. You have no business here. Go.
I work for the estate. I walk this landing at night. The landing belongs to the estate. So do the boats tied to it. Keep walking.
I keep this gate for the heirs. The stone house is their outer post. Third-Born Tsaxi says who goes in. Speak to him.
I am a lookout. I watch the stair and the water. If you have business here, talk to Bent-Spine, not to me.
I am a lookout. I watch the water. If you came down the trapdoor, Bent-Spine has been told.
